added: English dances offer a Longways formation, a longways set of no set number of couples.
changed: A Caller's Companion dance read as English that is danced in a Becket formation now comes across as a longways set described as "Becket" ("Becket CCW" for counterclockwise), still reading a circle "half way" as two places. Convert English dances reads a Becket dance the same way.
`ecdFormationShapes` includes `FormationShape.longways`, and `ecdFormationFromContra` maps `becketCw`/`becketCcw` to `longways` with the detail "Becket" / "Becket CCW".
`ecdRingDancers` takes the formation `detail` and reads a longways set described as a Becket as a ring of four; `parseFreeTextFigureEntry` takes `formationDetail`.
